request.raw_text: Scale the part 10x. Add drafts of 2 degrees to all vertical surfaces, with flat bottom surface as a hinge. Add rounds R=1mm to all inner edges and R=3mm to all outer edges. Exclude edges, inner or outer, on the flat bottom surface. Add two cylinder features with D=6mm and inner hole D=3mm. Cylinders should be spaced 30mm apart and shall be placed centered with respect to the main part. They should start on the flat bottom surface level and reach all the way to the part wall on the top side
action_words: Exclude edges on the flat bottom surface
reference_geometry_words: part wall on the top side

aim.primary_aim: Produce a 10-times-scaled main part with specified draft and non-bottom edge rounds, plus two centered, spaced, hollow cylindrical features extending from the bottom level to the top-side part wall.

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its flatness and exclude all inner and outer edges lying on it from the requested rounds; retain it as the draft hinge and cylindrical-feature start level.

geometry.description: The main part has final linear dimensions scaled by a factor of 10 relative to the original part.
All applicable vertical surfaces have a 2-degree draft referenced to the flat bottom surface as the hinge.
All applicable inner edges have 1 mm rounds, excluding inner edges on the flat bottom surface.

relationships.reference: edges on the flat bottom surface

geometry.description: All applicable outer edges have 3 mm rounds, excluding outer edges on the flat bottom surface.

geometry.description: Each cylindrical feature contains a 3 mm diameter inner hole coaxial with that cylindrical feature.

validation_criteria.description: Verify that the main part's linear dimensions are scaled relative to the original by the specified factor.
Verify that every applicable vertical surface has the specified draft angle.
Verify that the flat bottom surface is the hinge reference for the drafted vertical surfaces.
Verify that all applicable inner edges not on the flat bottom surface have the specified round radius.
Verify that all applicable outer edges not on the flat bottom surface have the specified round radius.
Verify that no inner or outer edge on the flat bottom surface receives a requested round.
Verify that the bottom reference surface remains flat.
Verify that exactly two cylindrical features exist.
Verify the outer diameter of each cylindrical feature.
Verify that the two cylindrical features have the specified spacing.
Verify that the cylindrical-feature pair is centered with respect to the main part.
Verify that both cylindrical features start at the flat bottom surface level and reach the part wall on the top side.
Verify that each cylindrical feature contains an inner hole of the specified diameter.
Verify that each inner hole is coaxial with its corresponding cylindrical feature.
Verify that non-targeted geometry is preserved except where required by the requested final-state changes.
